app.help.spend: How do I spend a gift?
app.help.spendAnswer:
Open your wallet from the home screen and tap Redeem.

Show the QR to the cashier. They enter the amount, and your vouchers pay for it. The QR is good for 2 minutes, and you can always show a new one.

What you do not spend stays in your wallet.
app.help.notReceived: My friend did not get the gift
app.help.notReceivedAnswer:
Gifts that U GIFT sends arrive on WhatsApp within a moment.

If your friend cannot find it, open Gifts I sent in your profile and tap Resend to share the link yourself.

A gift sent to a phone number also lands in their wallet when they sign in with that number.
app.help.claimAnswer:
Open your wallet and tap Claim a physical voucher.

Scan the QR on the card, or type the code printed on it. The amount joins your wallet balance, and the card's own code stops working.
app.help.expiryAnswer:
Each gift shows its expiry date in your wallet, and what you do not spend stays there until then.

For anything about refunds, chat with us on WhatsApp and we will help.

app.legal.termsBody:
These terms apply when you use U GIFT to buy, send, receive and spend gift vouchers.

You need a Jordanian mobile number to create an account. Keep your password to yourself; you are responsible for what happens on your account.

A voucher can be spent at the stores it was bought for, until its expiry date. We may update these terms, and we will tell you in the app when we do.
app.legal.privacyBody:
We keep your name, your phone number and the gifts you send and receive, so we can deliver gifts and keep your wallet up to date.

We share a recipient's name and number only to deliver their gift. Stores see only what they need to redeem it at the counter.

You can ask us to delete your account at any time from Terms and privacy.
app.legal.vouchersBody:
Each voucher shows its value, where it can be spent and when it expires. What you do not spend stays in your wallet until then.

A printed card joins your wallet once you claim it, and its own code stops working.

Refunds are looked at one by one. Chat with us on WhatsApp and we will help.
app.legal.deleteBody: Your account, saved addresses and gift history will be removed. This cannot be undone.
